children: RBC Capital Markets cut its price target on UiPath
to $15 from $17 while maintaining a Sector Perform rating after the software company's first investor day since 2022.

RBC said UiPath is positioning itself beyond robotic process automation (RPA) toward business orchestration and automation, combining deterministic workflows with AI-based automation and human decisions."While we like UiPath's vision for bridging deterministic workflows with agentic automation, we ultimately believe it remains a show-me story as we watch for improved results," said RBC analysts.

UiPath said AI annual recurring revenue reached $250M in the second quarter, up from about $200M in the fourth quarter. The company defines AI ARR as revenue from agentic automation, Maestro, intelligent document processing, and vertical solutions.
UiPath has identified three main growth areas: expanding its RPA customer base into its broader platform, adding customers through vertical solutions, and growing its application-testing business.
RBC lowered its price target mainly because of lower valuation multiples among software peers. The firm based its new $15 target on 3.9 times its 2027 revenue estimate.
